# Admonition Demo

This runbook demonstrates the `<Admonition>` block, which renders a callout box for a note, info, warning, or danger message.

## 1. Types

<Admonition type="note" description="A **note** adds context the reader can skip." />

<Admonition type="info" description="An **info** callout points out something helpful." />

<Admonition type="warning" description="A **warning** flags something that can go wrong." />

<Admonition type="danger" description="A **danger** callout flags something that can't be undone." />

## 2. Markdown content

Put the message between the tags, on lines of its own, to write it in markdown, with lists, code blocks, and links.

<Admonition type="info" title="Before you begin">
You need:

- The AWS CLI
- OpenTofu v1.6 or later

Then:

1. Sign in to AWS.
2. Check which account you're signed in to:

```bash
aws sts get-caller-identity
```

Read the [`<Admonition>` docs](https://runbooks.gruntwork.io/authoring/blocks/admonition/) for every prop.
</Admonition>

## 3. Dismissing

<Admonition type="note" title="Closable" description="Close this callout with the **X**." closable={true} />

<Admonition
    type="danger"
    title="Confirmation"
    description="Click the button to acknowledge this callout and dismiss it."
    confirmationText="I understand"
/>
